verdict.rationale: Jira can serve as a shared system of record that tools and agents read and write. The evidence shows rich APIs, REST/JQL querying praised by users, an official Atlassian MCP server for agent access, automation that syncs tools like Slack and Bitbucket, and Rovo AI pulling context from Confluence, Figma and third-party apps. However, nothing documents an explicit handoff mechanism between tools or agents, or any guarantee that context is preserved when work moves between them. missing for 10: documented agent-to-agent or tool-to-tool handoff workflow, explicit context/state preservation across handoffs, hands-on corroboration of agent handoff via the MCP server.
